summary: Google DeepMind and India's Atal Innovation Mission launched a pilot of ATL Saathi, a Gemini-powered web app giving Tinkering Lab teachers curriculum summaries, project-generation tools, and multilingual support across 100 pilot schools.

practices.reason: The document names a specific model version powering the feature but gives no benchmark or comparative detail, only a product description.
practices.quote: Our latest Gemini 3.5 Flash model instantly generates grade-appropriate, curriculum-aligned project ideas to spark student curiosity and provides educators with step-by-step assembly instructions, wiring diagrams, and safety precautions for unique problem statements brought forward by students.
